context: This criteria evaluates the correct use of HTTP method functions (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) with the HTTP client library to perform basic CRUD operations.

checklist.name: GET request
checklist.description: Uses the appropriate method to perform a GET request to retrieve data from the API endpoint

checklist.name: POST request
checklist.description: Uses the appropriate method to send data in a POST request to create a new resource

checklist.name: PUT request
checklist.description: Uses the appropriate method to send data in a PUT request to update an existing resource

checklist.name: DELETE request
checklist.description: Uses the appropriate method to perform a DELETE request to remove a resource
